summary: The agent implements strong domain-specific feature engineering and an appropriate model retraining strategy for final predictions. However, it fails to apply feature scaling before using a distance-based SVR model, rendering the SVR essentially useless. Additionally, it skips basic data cleaning, evaluates models on a single random split using only one metric, and leaks validation information by using the early-stopping set to compute ensemble weights.
